problem.title: Most EAs weren't built for indices
problem.transition: Topstock was built to solve all three.

dna.title: Wrong instrument DNA
dna.body: Gold moves 100-300 points a day. NAS100 moves 500-800. Trailing stops tuned for XAUUSD hemorrhage profit the moment you point them at an index.

hedge.title: Wrong hedge logic
hedge.body: Symmetric hedging assumes a range-bound market. NAS100 and US30 have carried an upward bias for decades — a BUY-heavy strategy captures more of that, not less.

timing.title: Wrong entry scale
timing.body: EMA-based entries that work on gold at $2,000 do not translate to an index at $20,000. The timing has to be recalibrated to the scale of the price.

solution.title: Built for indices from the first line

native.title: Index-native strategy
native.body: Not a gold EA repurposed. Every parameter — entry timing, hedge triggers, trail distances, exit targets — was tuned specifically for NAS100 and US30 volatility patterns.

trail.title: Fast Points Trail (v1.1)
trail.body: EMA-based trailing lags by hundreds of points on fast indices. Topstock's Fast Points Trail reacts within 300 points of price — protecting profit before the giveback.

cent.title: Cent-account safe
cent.body: Test the strategy with real money at $0.0001 per point of risk. Start with $10 on FBS Cent and scale to a standard account once it's proven.

howItWorks.title: Four stages of the mechanism
howItWorks.description: Every figure below is the real value from the EA source, not a marketing number.

entry.title: Anticipation Batch Entry
entry.body: When price enters the last 20% of the EMA100→EMA200 gap, Topstock opens a 5-order batch anticipating the reversal. Direction is set by EMA100 against EMA200.

confirm.title: Cross Confirmation
confirm.body: If price crosses EMA100 in the batch direction, one additional confirmation order is added — increasing size in the direction of momentum.

recovery.title: Independent Grid Recovery
recovery.body: All 6 grids operate independently. The first hedge level triggers at 1,500 points adverse (ANT batch) or 1,000 points (Cross order), and every level after that steps every 1,000 points. Every hedge is a BUY.

exit.title: Dynamic Exit
exit.body: A grid closes when net P/L reaches a target scaled to position size: 300 points × total lots × value per point. The bigger the grid, the proportionally bigger the move it needs.

items.selfHealing: Self-healing close logic retries automatically when the broker rejects an order
items.iterationCap: Hard cap of 30 iterations per tick prevents runaway loops
items.phaseManagement: V2 phase management preserves the original position throughout recovery

trial.q: How do I get the free backtest?
trial.a: Fill in the form on the trial page with the broker you use and the symbol you're interested in (NAS100 or US30). Our team replies via Line or Telegram within 24 hours with your backtest report.

mustConsult.q: Do I have to talk to the team before buying?
mustConsult.a: No — if you already understand the EA and how to configure it, you can ask for a payment link straight away. But we recommend a conversation first, to be sure the EA suits your broker, account, and trading style — it prevents buying something that won't work for you.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: PromptPay (for Thai bank accounts), bank transfer, or Stripe (for credit cards and international customers). We send the payment link after the consultation.

included.a: The ready-to-run EA (.ex5), unlimited MT5 account activations, free updates across v1.x, a 30-60 minute setup call, and the Line support group. No monthly fee, no hidden costs.

refund.q: Is there a refund if I'm not satisfied?
refund.a: Yes — a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. Contact us on Line or by email at support if you'd like a refund.

whyConsult.a: Because every EA has its own character. We want to be sure you understand the right broker and account type (cent vs standard), the minimum capital to use, the risk parameters to set, and how to monitor and adjust. Customers who understand the strategy from the start get better results and need less support — both sides win.

priceCompare.q: How does this price compare to other EAs?
priceCompare.a: Quality EAs on the market run roughly $99-$999 (฿3,500-฿35,000). Topstock is priced at ฿4,900 — mid-tier, not the cheapest, but weighed against an exclusive focus on indices (not a generic EA), a consultation before purchase, human review of each activation, and free updates across the v1.x line.

brokers.a: Any MT5 broker offering NAS100 / US100 / USTEC or US30 / DJ30. Our customers mainly use FBS (cent account for testing), Exness, and XM.

minimum.a: $10 on a cent account (such as FBS Cent) is enough to test the strategy safely. For a live standard account we recommend $500 minimum so position sizing is meaningful.

vps.q: Do I need to keep MT5 running 24/5?
vps.a: Yes — MT5 must be running during market hours. We recommend renting a VPS (around $5-15/month) for stable 24/5 operation. The setup guide includes VPS recommendations.
